exercises.text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: All calendars are the same.
The solar calendar is based on the Sun.
Different calendars have dissimilar bases.
The lunar month is twenty-nine and a half days long.

exercises.text: How is the information in the passage organized?
options: Characteristics of the solar calendar are outlined.
Two types of calendars are described.
The strengths and weakness of the lunar calendar are described.
The length of each existing calendar is contrasted.

exercises.text: Which of the following expresses the main idea of the passage?
options: Vaccines provide immunity to specific disease
Vaccines contain disease-causing microorganism
Vaccines are derived in different ways
New approaches in administering vaccines are being developed

exercises.text: How many types of vaccines are presented in the passage?
options: Two
Three
Four
Five

exercises.text: The topic of this passage could be best described as?
options: The Piltdown Man
Charles Dawson’s discovery
Eoanthropus dawsoni
A definition and example of a hoax

exercises.text: The author’s main point is that
options: Various types of hoaxes have been perpetrated
Charles Dawson discovered a human skull and jawbone
Charles Dawson was not an honest man
The human skull and jawbone were extremely old
